_comment: Headline and sub-line drawn above each App Store screenshot by scripts/caption_screenshots.py. Keys are the filenames the screenshots workflow writes. Headlines are plain feature names so they read like the rest of the app's copy; the sub-line carries the detail and the search terms. 06_watch.png has no entry on purpose: the watch slot is too small for a header and Apple needs the exact capture size.

01_today.png.headline: The bite, hour by hour
01_today.png.subline: Pressure, tide, solunar and weather, scored 0 to 100 with the reasons shown

02_map.png.headline: Tap any water
02_map.png.subline: See whether it's worth a cast. Boat ramps, depth, radar and offline regions on the map

03_catches.png.headline: Photo-first catch log
03_catches.png.subline: Pin-drop spots, AR length, personal bests and streaks

04_fish.png.headline: 1,500 species, ID on device
04_fish.png.subline: A field guide you fill in, and what's biting this month

05_community.png.headline: Crews and tournaments, opt-in
05_community.png.subline: Leaderboards, weekly challenges and live standings. Your spots stay yours.
